title: Rav Yosef bar Manyumi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was a disciple of Rav Nachman, as in [Ketubot 100b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.100b.14), where he said, “It was explained to me by Rav Nachman himself.” We repeatedly find the formula “Rav Yosef bar Manyumi said: Rav Nachman said,” as in Berakhot 23a; Eruvin 45 and 76b; Yevamot 101b and 106b; Ketubot 81b; Gittin 9a, 45b and 70b; Bava Kamma 97a; Bava Metzia 15b, 32a and 64b; Bava Batra 132a, 145a, 148b and 159a; Shevuot 47; and Chullin 13b, 46a and 48a.[^1]

We also find Rav Yosef bar Manyumi saying, “Rav Sheshet said,” in [Gittin 71a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.71a.8); and Rav Manyumi son of Rav Nachumi said it in his name, as in [Ketubot 81b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.81b.8-11).[^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives Eruvin 45 and Shevuot 47 without an a/b marker.
The antecedent of ‘in his name’ is unstated.
